budget_protocol.blocking_selection: fastest full tuning median among configurations within the hard allocated-index budget and reaching 95% exact-NN success within the per-query deadline
budget_protocol.baseline_selection: fastest full tuning median among configurations within the same hard allocated-index budget and reaching 95% exact-NN success within the per-query deadline
budget_protocol.tuning_guard_note: 95% empirical tuning is a conservative selection guard for a 90% held-out exact-NN-within-deadline requirement; it is not a population-recall certificate.
budget_protocol.posting_compression: unique (fingerprint,parent) per table for every indexed method
budget_protocol.feasibility_scope: largest feasible TESTED k in 4..12; every required index seed must meet the serving-index budget and 90% exact-NN success within 10 ms; raw curves and scratch RAM are separate

selection_note: Preserve the historical exact-neighbor tuning target; this is not retuning to a test-set quality threshold.
quality_note: Report both 1.1 and 1.25 approximation success over all queries; condition ratio means and tails on returned answers.
scope_note: Only Blocking switches to first hit; baselines retain their measured verified behavior. Endpoint families remain valid Blocking configurations in the partition study.
